resources.string: Taking photos needs the camera permission.

plurals.name: camera_photo_instructions
plurals.item: Point the phone at something with detail and good light, then start. The camera takes one photo.
Point the phone at something with detail and good light, then start. Each of the %1$d cameras takes one photo.

resources.string: Do the photos look right (sharp, correct colors, the expected lens)?
Recording video needs the camera and microphone permissions.
Records %1$d s with sound on %2$s, then checks duration, video and audio tracks.
Play each clip. Are the picture and the sound right on all of them?
Testing camera interfaces needs camera and microphone access.
Use a well-lit scene. This tests each camera through both app APIs; it cannot switch HAL versions. Connect Shizuku to read the HAL inventory.
Have you reviewed every photo and clip, including sound, and confirmed all exposed HAL versions are covered?
Camera1: camera %1$d photo and video (camera %2$d of %3$d)
The stress test records video, so it needs the camera and microphone.

Leave the phone on a table. Each step opens a random camera and takes a photo, records 0.5 to 3 s, closes the camera mid-recording or churns autofocus, with 0.1 to 0.8 s between steps. Then every camera is reopened once.
The stress test records from the microphones.

Short beeps play on the speaker and earpiece while the mics record. Each step is random, with 0.1 to 0.8 s gaps. A first mic buffer slower than %1$d ms fails, since it means the audio HAL is blocking.
